The maths study

Read about the study. Then guess: up, down or about the same?

Nearly 1,000 high-school students in Turkey practised maths in four lessons, and after each practice they took an exam alone, without AI. Each class was in one of three groups. One group had no AI, only books and notes. One group had an AI chatbot that gave answers when asked. One group had an AI tutor that asked questions and gave hints, but never the answer. How did the two AI groups do, compared with the group without AI?
